items.title: Jins tay karne ke nizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-determination systems (PDF 103-105).

blocks.text: Drosophila, mammals aur zyada tar doosre vertebrates mein sex chromosome jora daande jaisa X aur kunde jaisa Y hai: maada XX aur nar XY. Drosophila mein autosomes ke 3 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora; insanon mein autosomes ke 22 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora.

Maada homogametic hai: us ke sab eggs mein aik X hota hai. Nar heterogametic hai: us ke aadhe sperm mein X aur aadhon mein Y. X wala sperm egg ko fertilize kare to XX zygote banta hai jo zanana tolidi aaza banata hai; Y wala sperm XY zygote deta hai jo mardana tolidi aaza banata hai.

Yeh kuch keeron mein milta hai. Tidde (grasshopper) ke 22 autosomes (11 jore) hain. Nar ke kul 23 chromosomes hain kyunke us ka sex chromosome 'jora' XO hai: sirf aik X aur koi Y nahi. Woh do qisam ke sperm banata hai, aadhe X wale aur aadhe baghair sex chromosome ke; baghair sex chromosome ke gamete ko nullo gamete kehte hain. Maada ke 24 chromosomes XX ke saath hain aur us ke sab eggs mein aik X. X sperm se XX maada aur nullo sperm se XO nar banta hai.

Yeh parindon mein aam hai. Parindon mein autosomes ki tadaad mukhtalif hoti hai, lekin sex chromosomes maada mein ZW aur nar mein ZZ hain. Maada do qisam ke eggs banati hai, aadhe Z aur aadhe W wale, jab ke nar ke sab sperm mein Z hota hai. Z wala egg sperm se fertilize ho to nar (ZZ) aur W wala egg maada (ZW) banta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. Insan (XX-XY nizam): maada 44 + XX, nar 44 + XY; maada gametes X, X aur nar gametes X, Y se XX aur XY. Tidda (XX-XO nizam): maada 22 + XX, nar 22 + X-; nar gametes X aur - (koi sex chromosome nahi) se XX aur X-. Murghi (ZW-ZZ nizam): maada 76 + ZW, nar 76 + ZZ; maada gametes Z, W aur nar gametes Z, Z se ZZ aur ZW. Maada bachche hare, nar gulabi.

blocks.long_description: Har hisse mein 2 x 2 grid: baen Female gametes, oopar Male gametes.

blocks.title: Chhape hue matan par note
blocks.text: Kitab parindon ke liye 'When a Y carrying egg is fertilized ... offspring is female' chhapti hai; ZW-ZZ nizam mein egg mein W hota hai, Y nahi.

blocks.prompt: Parindon mein bachche ki jins kaun sa walid tay karta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Maa: woh ZW hai aur Z aur W eggs banati hai, jab ke baap (ZZ) sirf Z sperm banata hai.

items: XX-XY (insan, Drosophila): nar heterogametic; sperm tay karta.
XX-XO (tidda): nar XO, 23 chromosomes; nullo sperm.
ZW-ZZ (parinde): maada heterogametic; egg tay karta.
